supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park launched Remote Desktop to DC-HD-01 from WS-LPARK-01 at 13:32:03, and the workstation recorded a connection to the domain controller on port 3389 shortly afterward. These records do not establish that an RDP logon to the domain controller succeeded.
Lucy Park successfully established an RDP logon to FILE-HD-01 from WS-LPARK-01 at 13:36:07.

The available records show potentially relevant remote-access activity by the help desk user before the alert time, but do not link Lucy, either remote session, or any logged action to creation of tmp.rwong.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records contain no directory-service account-creation event for tmp.rwong and no record identifying the account creator.
The supplied records do not show tmp.rwong's group memberships, privileges, enabled state, or subsequent sign-in activity.
The records show an RDP connection attempt to DC-HD-01 but include no corresponding domain-controller logon outcome.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was created by Lucy Park, another authorized help desk user, or an unauthorized actor.
Whether the account was added only to Temp-Staff or granted additional privileges.
Whether Lucy Park's RDP activity to DC-HD-01 or FILE-HD-01 was approved and related to the account creation.
Whether the account creation had a legitimate request or business purpose.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain domain-controller audit events for the account creation, including creator identity, timestamp, account attributes, and any group or privilege changes.
Review authentication and session logs on DC-HD-01 to determine whether the RDP activity from WS-LPARK-01 succeeded and which account authenticated.
Check the help desk request or change record for tmp.rwong and verify the account's intended duration and Temp-Staff-only assignment.
Confirm whether Lucy Park's remote sessions to DC-HD-01 and FILE-HD-01 were authorized.
unrelated_findings: Slack access from WS-LPARK-01 is visible in proxy records; Slack is not among the listed approved services. This finding is separate from the account alert. (T008-00040, T008-00041, T008-00043, T008-00044, T008-00045, T008-00046, T008-00047, T008-00048, T008-00049, T008-00050)
A Dropbox client started on WS-LPARK-01; Dropbox is not among the listed approved services. The supplied records do not establish that it transferred files. (T008-00055, T008-00056, T008-00057)

The GlobalProtect client process ran on WS-LPARK-01; the inventory says there is no VPN, but these records alone do not establish a VPN connection or relate the process to tmp.rwong. (T008-00072, T008-00073, T008-00074)
